csv_project_name: CM Services for Labor and Industries Building Renovation
csv_agency: Oregon Dept of Admin Services Facilities Division
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Oregon (the State ), acting by and through its Department of Administrative Services ( DAS ), State Procurement Services ( DAS SPS ), on behalf of Department of Administrative Services, Enterprise Asset Management ( DAS EAM ) (collectively, the Owner ), through this Request for Proposals ( RFP ) requests Proposals from experienced construction manager/general contractor ( CM/GC ) firms for the CM/GC delivery of the Labor & Industries Building Modernization located at 350 Winter Street NE Salem, Oregon (the Project ), which will include preconstruction services (the Preconstruction Services or Preconstruction Phase Services ), and renovation and construction services (the Construction Services or Construction Phase Services ), and all related supportservices(collectively, the Work ). The Labor & Industries Building is located on the Capitol Mall in Salem, Oregon at 350 Winter Street NE. The building is approximately 183,000 square feet with four floors above ground and a basement which has a tunnel connection to the Capitol Mall Parking Structure. The building was constructed in 1961 with various state agency tenants over the years. The grounds surrounding the building, including the Capitol Mall and the landscaping on the west and south sides of the building, are maintained by the State Parks and Recreation Department, which will be a Project stakeholder. Other Project stakeholders include the building tenants, DAS Operations and Maintenance, and DAS Information Technology (IT).
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management
